description: End-to-end SD-WAN incident lifecycle from detection and triage through mitigation, change implementation, verification, and resolution for B2B customers.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for the enterprise customer (tenant).

site_id.description: Identifier for a specific SD-WAN site or branch.

device_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN edge device or CPE.

circuit_id.description: Identifier for an underlay WAN circuit (e.g., MPLS, DIA, LTE).

incident_id.description: Unique identifier of an SD-WAN incident or trouble ticket.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a configuration change request associated with an incident.

diagnostic_session_id.description: Identifier for a temporary diagnostic or test session.

user_id.description: Identifier of a user (NOC engineer, customer admin, automation user).

functions.name: detect_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Ingest alerts and context to detect or correlate an SD-WAN incident for a tenant and affected sites.

tenant_id.description: Tenant for which the alert was generated.

ingest_source.description: Source system that raised the alert.

primary_alert.description: Primary alert that triggered the detection.

metrics.description: Key metric values at the time of alert.

correlated_alerts.description: Additional alerts that may correlate to the same incident.

correlation_hint.description: Hints for incident correlation and deduplication.

dedup_key.description: Key for deduplicating into an existing incident.

lookback_minutes.description: Time window for correlating recent alerts.

force_new_incident.description: If true, always create a new incident instead of correlating.

reported_by.description: Information about who or what reported the issue.

functions.returns: New or existing incident ID with initial state, severity, and correlation details.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific SD-WAN incident.

include.description: Additional sections of data to include.

mask_sensitive.description: If true, mask sensitive fields (e.g., IP, customer PII).

functions.returns: Full incident record with status, impact, history, and optionally timeline, diagnostics, and changes.

functions.name: list_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: List and filter SD-WAN incidents for one or more tenants or sites.

tenant_id.description: Filter by tenant; if omitted, returns incidents for all accessible tenants.

functions.returns: Paginated list of incidents with summary fields and optional counts per status/severity.

functions.name: run_sd_wan_diagnostics
functions.description: Launch an on-demand diagnostic session for an SD-WAN incident across affected sites, devices, and circuits.

sites.description: Sites included in diagnostics. If empty, infer from incident.

devices.description: Specific devices to target within the sites.

direction.description: Traffic direction for the test, if applicable.

auto_infer_scope.description: If true, derive scope from incident impact when not explicitly provided.

functions.returns: Diagnostic session ID with list of scheduled tests and estimated completion times.

functions.name: get_diagnostic_results
functions.description: Fetch results and status for a diagnostic session related to an incident.

include_raw_output.description: Include raw command outputs and traces.

include_metrics_summary.description: Include aggregated metrics and health scores.

filter.description: Filter which tests or entities to include.

functions.returns: Diagnostic session status, per-test results, aggregated metrics, and optional raw outputs.

functions.name: analyze_incident_root_cause
functions.description: Analyze diagnostics and telemetry to infer likely root cause and impacted scope for an SD-WAN incident.

diagnostic_session_id.description: Optional related diagnostic session to use in analysis.

override_context.description: Optional manual context to guide analysis.

functions.returns: Proposed root cause classification, confidence score, impacted entities, and recommended next actions.

functions.name: propose_sd_wan_remediation
functions.description: Generate and validate a remediation plan (including potential config changes and workarounds) for the incident.

constraints.description: Operational and business constraints on remediation.

maintenance_window.description: Window during which intrusive changes are allowed.

max_impact_minutes.description: Maximum allowed additional outage time during change.

require_manual_approval_for.description: Types of changes needing manual approval.

functions.returns: Structured remediation plan including steps, risk level, and indication of which steps need approval.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_change_request
functions.description: Create a formal SD-WAN configuration change request linked to an incident and remediation plan.

scope.description: Scope of the change across sites, devices, and circuits.

entity_id.description: Identifier of the entity being changed (e.g., policy name).

risk_assessment.description: Risk and impact details for the change.

scheduled_window.description: Planned time window for implementing the change.

functions.returns: Change request ID with initial status, approval requirements, and summary of proposed changes.

functions.name: apply_sd_wan_change_request
functions.description: Execute an approved SD-WAN change request and track implementation progress.

execution_mode.description: Mode in which to execute the change.

batches.description: Definition of batches for staged rollout.

functions.returns: Execution job details with per-site/device results, failures if any, and overall execution status.

functions.name: rollback_sd_wan_change
functions.description: Rollback a failed or unsafe SD-WAN change associated with a change request and incident.

sites.description: Only for partial rollback: sites to revert.

devices.description: Only for partial rollback: devices to revert.

functions.returns: Rollback job ID with status, scope of changes reverted, and any residual issues.

functions.name: verify_sd_wan_service_recovery
functions.description: Verify whether SD-WAN service has recovered after remediation by checking KPIs and running targeted tests.

sites.description: Sites to include in verification; defaults to impacted sites.

run_active_tests.description: Whether to run active probes (ping/path tests) in addition to passive monitoring.

change_request_id.description: Optional related change request to verify.

functions.returns: Verification result with pass/fail status, KPI snapshots, deviations, and recommended next steps.

functions.name: resolve_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Mark an SD-WAN incident as resolved or closed after successful verification or accepted workaround.

verification_summary.description: Summary of how resolution was validated.

linked_change_requests.description: Change requests that contributed to resolution.

functions.returns: Updated incident record with final status, resolution metadata, and closure timestamp.

functions.name: retry_or_reopen_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Handle cases where an incident needs retry of remediation or reopening after premature resolution.

previous_diagnostic_session_id.description: Diagnostic session to clone or re-run when retrying diagnostics.

previous_change_request_id.description: Change request to retry or derive new one from.

options.description: Additional options depending on the action type.

force_new_change_request.description: If true, do not reuse previous change request.

functions.returns: Updated incident state and IDs of any new diagnostic sessions or change requests created for retry.

functions.name: search_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Faceted search across SD-WAN incidents with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of SD-WAN incident summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Create multiple SD-WAN incidents in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created SD-WAN incident ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many SD-WAN incidents with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each SD-WAN incident, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many SD-WAN incidents in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each SD-WAN incident, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Export SD-WAN incident datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Bulk-import SD-WAN incident records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated SD-WAN incidents.

functions.name: subscribe_to_sd_wan_incident_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive SD-WAN incident lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_incident_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a SD-WAN incident, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the SD-WAN incident, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_sd_wan_incident_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for SD-WAN incidents using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the SD-WAN incident action.

functions.name: simulate_sd_wan_incident_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a SD-WAN incident without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the SD-WAN incident, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_sd_wan_incident_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a SD-WAN incident change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the SD-WAN incident under change.

functions.name: decide_sd_wan_incident_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending SD-WAN incident approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: add_sd_wan_incident_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a SD-WAN incident for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: upload_sd_wan_incident_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a SD-WAN incident with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_incident_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a SD-WAN incident (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the SD-WAN incident version captured.

functions.name: restore_sd_wan_incident_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a SD-WAN incident from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_incident_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for SD-WAN incidents over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the SD-WAN incident domain context.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_incident_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for SD-WAN incidents combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the SD-WAN incident context.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_incident_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to SD-WAN incidents with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current SD-WAN incidents.

functions.name: evaluate_sd_wan_incident_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a SD-WAN incident in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_incident_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a SD-WAN incident including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the SD-WAN incident, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_sd_wan_incident_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a SD-WAN incident and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: assign_sd_wan_incident_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a SD-WAN incident with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the SD-WAN incident with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more SD-WAN incidents, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each SD-WAN incident.

functions.name: compare_sd_wan_incident_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a SD-WAN incident with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the SD-WAN incident, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_sd_wan_incident_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to SD-WAN incident operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of SD-WAN incident operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_sd_wan_incident_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a SD-WAN incident and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the SD-WAN incident, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Clone a SD-WAN incident into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned SD-WAN incident record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_sd_wan_incident_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted SD-WAN incident report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the SD-WAN incident window covered.

functions.name: escalate_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Escalate a SD-WAN incident to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the SD-WAN incident.
